prompt: Hibernate XML mapping node attribute dot period format
answer:
In Hibernate XML mappings, the `node` attribute uses `"."` to map the property or entity data to the **parent XML element**.

Example:

```xml
<map name="accounts"
     node="."
     embed-xml="true">
</map>
```

The supported `node` formats are:

- `"element-name"` — maps to the named XML element
- `"@attribute-name"` — maps to the named XML attribute
- `"."` — maps to the parent element
- `"element-name/@attribute-name"` — maps to an attribute of the named element
